modelNotes: Points Board 1.4 reads from core, minutes, usage, opponent team defense, and opponent pace data.
Opponent points defense and pace apply a transparent adjustment capped at plus or minus 6 percent.
Expected minutes, rest, verified teammate absences, and recent-game volatility produce opportunity adjustments and projection ranges.

Foundation uses scoring average, last 5 form, last 10 form, enhanced expected minutes, minutes confidence, minutes trend, usage score, usage trend, volume acceleration, shot volume trend, free throw volume trend, and starter status.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Da Silva is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Kings due to a left calf strain.
injury.detail: Da Silva was a late addition to the injury report, which is never a good sign, but the severity of the issue remains unclear. If he joins Jalen Suggs (knee) and Paolo Banchero (ankle) on the sidelines, Jase Richardson, Jamal Cain and Jevon Carter would be candidates for increased roles.

injury.shortComment: Christie is questionable for Tuesday's game against the Suns due to a right ankle sprain, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.
injury.detail: Christie could be in street clothes for Tuesday's action, which would hurt the Clippers' depth off the bench. His status is unlikely to have a major impact on the rotation, though.
